name: Charge and throw sequence
prompt: Create a high-resolution landscape ACTION STORYBOARD for an original premium Roblox blocky creature collecting game. Pure WHITE production-sheet background, clean 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX panels with thin gray separators, soft neutral studio light. One consistent anonymous blocky humanoid Roblox avatar with dark navy/violet outfit, no face detail or logos, in the first two panels only. Same original violet/gold faceted portal orb and gate throughout. All assets are buildable from cuboid Parts and WedgeParts, clean planar geometry, no plush surfaces. Each panel is a SMALL ISOLATED 3D STUDIO SET on white, no full sky/background. Title 'THROW / SIX PRESENTATION BEATS'. Panel 1 '01 CHARGE': avatar plants feet on marble launch pad, right arm winds back holding glowing violet orb, tiny gold floor channels point forward; no huge particle cloud. Panel 2 '02 RELEASE': same avatar follows through with a forceful forward throwing arm pose, orb just leaving hand with a short tapered trail. Panel 3 '03 FLIGHT': same orb follows a clear elegant arcing trajectory over a small section of green open landing lane; a thin dotted curve suggests path and no avatar. Panel 4 '04 LAND': orb contacts ground, one restrained expanding gold/violet ring, tiny debris shapes, no damage. Panel 5 '05 OPEN': a magnificent structured violet/gold portal ring unfurls upright, inner spiral contained within ring, center passage open, no creature yet. Panel 6 '06 REVEAL': one beautiful BLOCKY emerald forest dragon with rose-pink planar wings and a long segmented tail steps through into a stable heroic pose, ring behind but face and full anatomy readable. Show anticipation/follow-through changes clearly, preserve scale consistency within each shot, no attack, no weapons, no gore, no random UI values or timing claims, no watermark. Good storytelling and clean restrained effects, not a battle scene.

name: Reveal and capture rarity direction
prompt: Create an original premium Roblox game VFX AND CAMERA reference board in a PURE WHITE studio. High-resolution landscape, clean 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX equal panels, minimal precise labels and clean white margins. Title 'REVEAL / RARITY AND CAPTURE'. Blocky hard-surface fantasy pet models, cuboid/wedge forms, narrow inset eyes, no plush anatomy, no excessive particles. This is a presentation storyboard, not gameplay combat. Top row three RARITY REVEAL panels: left 'COMMON': a simple moss-green blocky armored hare with long cuboid ears and plain squared paws, small neutral ground ring, quiet pose, no crown/aura; middle 'EPIC': an imposing dark basalt block golem with orange recessed seams, four clean armor masses per limb and one restrained violet accent ring, forceful planted brace; right 'LEGENDARY / MYTHICAL': a magnificent regal cream/emerald stag with tall branching mint-tipped geometric antlers, beautifully layered leaf armor, pale-gold rim and one elegant local light arc, absolutely clear face and majestic silhouette. Premium beauty comes from animal geometry not fog. Bottom row three CAPTURE beats using EXACT SAME premium stag above: left '01 ACKNOWLEDGE': stag lowers its head deliberately while a small gold ring forms above; middle '02 ASCEND': complete body gently lifts toward ring on a controlled curved path with one thin elegant trail, uniform whole-model contraction implied by smaller silhouette, no body squish; right '03 ADDED': a refined white/violet/gold collectible inventory reward card showing the SAME stag, exact small words 'CAUGHT' and 'ADDED TO PETS', one restrained small arrow points toward a simple small Pets icon. Keep actual odds/currency numbers absent. Use gorgeous original blocky props and coherent material hierarchy. No full-screen white flash, no combat attacks, no weapons, no fake screenshots, no watermarks.

name: Gym and income interaction sequence
prompt: Create a premium original Roblox INTERACTION ANIMATION REFERENCE on a pure WHITE studio production-sheet background, high-resolution landscape. Six equal panels in a 3-column by 2-row grid, soft neutral studio lighting, subtle contact shadows, light gray separators and clean labels. Cohesive violet/gold/cream sanctuary architecture and buildable cuboid/wedge hard-surface forms. One consistent anonymous Roblox blocky humanoid avatar in navy/violet outfit with no face detail, no logos. Title 'BASE / PURPOSEFUL INTERACTIONS'. Top row a THREE-FRAME GYM LIFT using same small iron barbell and black/gold gym mat: left '01 PREPARE' avatar plants feet gripping barbell at waist, arms extended and shoulders set; middle '02 LIFT' avatar bends elbows and brings barbell toward chest, stable torso, no deformed arms; right '03 RECOVER' controlled lowering to waist, one small warm-gold strength pulse near mat, no invented numeric gain. Bottom left '04 EQUIPMENT UPGRADE' isolated line of FIVE distinct miniature equipment silhouettes left to right: wooden dumbbell, iron barbell rack, golden kettlebell, faceted crystal weights, cosmic orbital gravity machine; a simple progression arrow, no prices. Bottom middle '05 COLLECT INCOME' avatar steps onto a bright GREEN inset collect pad beside a small marble crystal fountain, a short arc of a FEW angular gold coins travels to a simple money-icon marker, clear physical contact, no arbitrary currency amounts. Bottom right '06 PET ACKNOWLEDGEMENT' avatar holds one hand near a magnificent cream/purple blocky crystal war lion with angular purple/cyan wedge mane; lion gives a dignified lowered-head acknowledgement and a small rigid tail sweep, four heavy squared paws planted, no baby hop/cuddle/heart cloud. Keep all sets isolated on white, refined clean game design, no weapons, no combat, no gore, no watermark. Actions must read clearly and have controlled anticipation and recovery.
